Anzupgo (delgocitinib) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-510407  
Guideline Name 
Anzupgo (delgocitinib)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
3/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Anzupgo  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 158 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 158 
 
2 - Diagnosis of severe chronic hand eczema (CHE)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient is experiencing functional impairment due to severe chronic hand eczema, which 
may include, but is not limited to, activities of daily living (ADLs), skin infections, sleep 
disturbances, etc.  
 
AND 
 
4 - Provider attests patient has been counseled regarding avoidance of irritants and allergens  
 
AND 
 
5 - Submission of medical records or paid pharmacy claims documenting that patient is using 
emollients (e.g., Aquaphor, Eucerin) consistently  
 
AND 
 
6 - Submission of medical records or paid pharmacy claims documenting trial and failure of a 
minimum 30-day supply (14-day supply for topical corticosteroids), contraindication, or 
intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
Medium or higher potency topical corticosteroid  
• 
One calcineurin inhibitor (e.g., tacrolimus ointment)  
• 
Eucrisa (crisaborole)  
• 
Opzelura (ruxolitinib)  
• 
Vtama (tapinarof)  
• 
Zoryve (roflumilast) 0.05% or 0.15% cream  
• 
Adbry (tralokinumab-ldrm)  
 
AND 
 
7 - NOT used in combination with other Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors or potent 
immunosuppressants (e.g., azathioprine or cyclosporine)  


--- PDF page 159 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 159 
 
AND 
 
8 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Dermatologist  
• 
Allergist/Immunologist  
 
Product Name:Anzupgo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., erythema, scaling, 
hyperkeratosis, fissures)  
 
AND 
 
2 - NOT used in combination with other JAK inhibitors or potent immunosuppressants (e.g., 
azathioprine or cyclosporine)
